values.body_1: Custom parts in DuPont Kapton polyimide, one of the most versatile materials for medical, biotech, aerospace, automotive and photovoltaics.

Goodfellow Microfabrication has micromachined Kapton polyimide films for over 30 years, fabricating complex and simple parts on a prototyping or production basis. Our technology machines all types of Kapton polyimide, including hole drilling, cutting and more.

We stock Kapton HN film in 0.001 in, 0.003 in and 0.005 in thicknesses for rapid turnaround on custom prototype parts.
Kapton HNKapton FNKapton FCRKapton CRKapton HPP-STKapton PVKapton ENCirlexVespelMany more

Laser micromachining of micro-holes, blind holes, channels, complex shapes, washers and patterning. Precise channels can also be milled into Kapton and filled with conductive pastes and nano-materials.

Call us or send your drawing to discuss. For an immediate order, upload your drawing to our InstaQuote app.
